"""Camera-guided controller for select_mahjong. All robot I/O uses rcb_client."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def capture(r, name, seconds=0):
    res=r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, include_depth=True, video='none')
    res.save(OUT/name)
    for cam, arr in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(arr).save(OUT/name/f'{cam}.png')
    print(json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2))
    return res

if __name__=='__main__':
    r=Robot()
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    capture(r,'initial')
PY
